sql: WITH movements AS (SELECT i.issued_at AS occurred_at, i.invoice_total_amount AS amount FROM sales_invoices i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT d.occurred_at, d.amount FROM customer_debt_transactions d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.source_type = 'sales_return') SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS doanh_thu FROM movements WHERE occurred_at >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND occurred_at < DATE '2025-04-01'
SELECT COUNT(i.invoice_id) AS so_hoa_don FROM sales_invoices i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.issued_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < DATE '2025-04-01'
